mapper.select: SELECT b_id as bookId, b_name as name, b_unitPrice as unitPrice, b_author as author, b_description as description, b_publisher as publisher, b_category as category, b_unitsInStock as unitsInStock, b_releaseDate as releaseDate, b_condition as `condition`, b_filename as filename FROM book ORDER BY b_id DESC

SELECT b_id as bookId, b_name as name, b_unitPrice as unitPrice, b_author as author, b_description as description, b_publisher as publisher, b_category as category, b_unitsInStock as unitsInStock, b_releaseDate as releaseDate, b_condition as `condition`, b_filename as filename FROM book WHERE b_id = #{bookId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book ( b_id, b_name, b_unitPrice, b_author, b_description, b_publisher, b_category, b_unitsInStock, b_releaseDate, b_condition, b_filename ) VALUES ( #{bookId}, #{name}, #{unitPrice}, #{author}, #{description}, #{publisher}, #{category}, #{unitsInStock}, #{releaseDate}, #{condition}, #{filename} )
